profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software developer, experienced in feature implementation, scripting, tool development, game design, functional and certification procedures. Experienced working on a wide array of platforms, and projects performing various different tasks while remaining focused on the main project goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• App development for Android and iOS with Java / Kotlin, Objective C / Swift, and C++.
• AR development using Google's ARCore and Apple's ARKit libraries.
• Implementation of the Filament rendering engine on Android and desktop platforms.
• Experience with UIKit, SpriteKit, and SceneKit on iOS.
• Integration of ImageMetric's facial and body tracking SDKs into SceneKit and Filament renderers.
• GLTF extension creation and parsing within Filament and SceneKit.
• Maya plugin development in Python and C++.
• Development of in house tools with C++ and Python scripts.
• Provide technical and software feature support to the in house art team, implementing filters and 3d assets according to design guidelines and requirements.
• Shipped Swerve: Body AR Effects on the iOS App Store https://apps.apple.com/us/app/swerve-body-ar-effects/id1531999916

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
•	Lead Programmer on Star Chamber, a multimedia, self-improvement, educational app that was developed for Starizon for Windows, OSX, and iOS. Responsibilities included working with designers and artist on implementing core features.
•	Ensuring that the master GIT repository was in working order and validating other branches and commits before merging.
•	Ported the Star Chamber app to iOS with Xcode, using multi-platform libraries.
•	Implemented features and did general bug fixing on a shipyard simulator built on FlexSim using the QT UI framework.
•	Developed windows installers using the Wix XML toolset.
•	Prototyped mini games for a web and mobile app project using React Framework in Java Script. I did not enjoy working with React / Java Script and do not see myself doing this in the future.
•	Implemented speech recognition and speech to text with the IBM Watson api.
•	Maintained tools and Python automation script used for building and processing content from working uncompressed formats into game engine ready packages. Worked on export scripts used by Photoshop and export plugin used by Maya.
•	Built a fully automated content pipeline used to create and convert files and assets to our software and development specifications, also built several tools, editors, viewers, and scripts to facilitate artwork pipeline production. Worked on existing tools and editors to add previously unsupported functionality.
•	Experienced in Agile and Scrum management with Jira and Trello to prioritize features and bugs assignments during sprints.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Executed Test Plans and Test Cases on different combinations of software and hardware.
•	Implemented and executed automation scripts used for testing set top boxes.
•	Reported and verified software defects to the Quality Center/JIRA bug database.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
•	Worked on all new tutorials for the original and DLC characters using Lua.
•	Created a viewer that features color swapping and HSLS pixel shader support and replicates the game engine rendering, which is used by the artist to preview frames and colors of specific animations.

positions.title: Designer
positions.description:
•	Built a fully automated content pipeline used to create and convert files and assets to our software and development specifications, also built several tools, editors, viewers, and scripts to facilitate artwork pipeline production. Worked on existing tools and editors to add previously unsupported functionality.
•	Designed several prototype games and worked to bring them to a playable and presentable state, while also creating content test cases using Maya and Photoshop for use in the proprietary engine.
•	Scripted several AI systems, tutorials in Lua, and the final boss Marie on Skullgirls. Worked closely with the lead designer on making early passes and implementations on characters.
•	Worked with engineers creating test cases for the development of exporters and software by creating assets that were used as a blueprint for artist and designers to follow.

positions.title: QA Senior Tester
positions.description:
•	Built the multiplayer test network, manipulating network scenarios, creating test scripts, and managing a team of 10 on site testers coordinating with multiplayer programmers on issues, steps to reproduce large scale bugs.
•	Created a comprehensive test scripts and checklist on Excel that included past test cases and Nintendo DS/TWL guidelines that would be used by the whole team on certification passes. The checklist was adapted and utilized as a best practice by other Certification teams to be used on different platforms. This increased efficiency and thoroughness of the certification test resulting in a higher pass rate on first party submissions.
•	Assisted Leads and on several projects was fully responsible for stream lining database reports, creating test plans, and taking over lead responsibilities when needed.

positions.title: QA Senior Tester
positions.description:
•	Performed functional, certification testing and game play evaluation of projects, helping give feedback and analysis on game play ideas and design changes that would later be implemented by the developers on the project.
•	Worked onsite at a development studio and later in charge of another onsite test team that provided onsite build reporting and support to the development teams.

positions.title: Freelance Artist
positions.description: •	Modeled toy concepts and designs in 3d using Maya and 3ds Max creating concept shots and storyboards from the renders. Using concept drawings and turnarounds of the toys that where provided by the company, creating high poly models, textures, and skinned on to IK bones, to be posed, animated, and rendered using Maya. The software used during the process was Adobe After Effects, Adobe Photoshop, Autodesk Max, and Autodesk Maya.
